requirements.requirement: One-cell cardinal step per input, no diagonal movement
Step duration about 0.16-0.20 s (target 0.18 s)
Held direction repeats a step after about 0.22 s
Input buffer of about 0.12 s that expires (code buffers one direction with no expiry)
Pawn faces its last movement direction, also when the step is blocked
A dangerous step may be cancelled only before the pawn leaves its start cell
Shift+direction turns instantly without moving or reserving a cell
Turning cannot interrupt an active step or an attack impact window (turn branch currently runs before the moving check)
Blocked step gives visible or audible bump feedback, never silent input loss (step_blocked event has no consumer in main.gd)
Reserve-then-commit grid occupancy; both cells held during a step; no collision mid-step
Pixel-snapped motion and camera, no subpixel blur (camera eases with smoothing_speed 8.0, no snap found)
Every gameplay verb has a keyboard and a controller mapping (project.godot has zero joypad events)
Full input remapping
InputMap actions for Interact (E), Call child (R), Select help, Focus, Pause (project.godot holds only move, attack, skill_1, turn_mode, restart_room)
B, F3 and F11 become InputMap actions instead of raw key polls
Room restart must not share the R key with Call child; restart moves to pause menu or hold
Controls explainable in one small panel (today a static HelpLabel)
Wooden Sword hits one adjacent cell in the facing direction; damage lands on the impact frame
Sword recovery about 0.30 s so spamming is worse than reading
Pawn cannot move during the first part of a swing (MovementSystem never reads PlayerCombat)
A hit staggers common enemies briefly
Attacking an armored face causes recoil and no damage
No combo strings
Target cells locked at swing start; one damage application per swing
Player invulnerability window after a hit (0.7 s)
Pencil Thrust: two-cell line on Q, impact 0.11 s, recovery 0.52 s, cooldown 1.25 s
Enemy telegraph locks target cells so stepping out dodges; token released on dodge
One room-level attack token prevents simultaneous enemy strikes
Hit feedback: flash, chip particles, small shake (stronger on player damage), hit-stop only if it helps clarity
Sword attack refused before the sword unlock, with HUD feedback
Player loadout of one toy weapon plus up to two Imagination skills, changed only at safe zones
Weapons change rhythm and geometry (Pencil Spear, Ruler Blade, Eraser, Chalk Line), not stats; the player must be able to pick weapons up (only enemies take items today)
Focus: hold to emphasise enemy telegraphs without stopping time
Assist option that slows enemies while the pawn is stationary
F3 debug overlay explains each enemy decision, off by default in builds
Rule Step: fast two-cell emergency move with cooldown, earned from the Knight boss
Chalk Path: child-assisted temporary walkable route, earned from the Bishop boss
Eraser Guard: guard or parry against straight-line attacks, earned from the Rook boss
Final Rule Break: one-time story power (first unassisted diagonal step) that opens the Black Castle and ends the King
Each skill has a boss or room that earns it, a safe teach, a combat test, an optional mastery use
Skills change decisions and never replace one-cell movement
HUD shows only unlocked skills with cooldown (Q THRUST only today)
Child intervention system with a Believe meter (max 2 calls; refills from hits, rescues, brave acts; bosses give controlled refills)
Place or Move Block on a highlighted empty cell: stops projectiles, Rook charges, Knight landings; not under a unit
Draw Chalk Path across up to three gap cells; fades in boss arenas
Place Paper Bridge over broken tiles
Erase Rule Mark disables a marked hazard or lock briefly
Hold Ruler Gate opens a shortcut or timed path
Turn the Board rotates an authored marked room section 90 degrees
Gentle Nudge moves the pawn one otherwise illegal diagonal cell with brief immunity
Help changes the room, never enemy HP, and cannot clear a phase by itself
Targeting mode: valid cells in blue within 5 cells, time slows to 35 percent, cancel costs nothing
Child hand sprite: larger and smoother than the chess world, never a cursor or divine beam (160x120 or larger)
Child actions animate physically, slower and heavier than pawn combat
Child intervention sounds from crayon, paper, block, eraser, cloth
Bosses can temporarily disrupt help (Queen Tear Drawing, King Close the Box)
Interventions authored per room (allowed types and placement)
Crayon-blue visual language reserved for child help
Three Courage points; boss signature attacks may remove two
Rescued white pieces restore one Courage at fixed safe locations; three optional rescues
On defeat return to the latest checkpoint with the room reset; no progress lost (code reloads the scene at the last entry)
Boss defeat resets the boss room to phase one, retries are fast
Checkpoints before bosses, at hubs, after major rewards
Pickup reset rule: room pickups reset unless marked persistent (code keeps every taken pickup forever)
Low-health state gets feedback (colour change only today)
Death rule explainable in one sentence; copy 'The child resets the board'
Major unlocks persist across death
Persist zone, entry, taken pickups, opened gates, unlocks, rule pages to disk
New Game, Continue and a clean-start path (WorldState.reset has no caller)
Cleared rooms and defeated bosses persist (bosses never reset)
Settings (volume, shake, accessibility) persist
Save format versioned so it can grow; an old save must not break a new build

summary:
Answer key: 249 requirements extracted from the GDD, v2 design, slice/soulslike/map plans, Act 1 flow map, T1 spec, the 76 lane specs (all read), five review batches, aspect specs, AGENTS/CLAUDE/task_plan/findings/progress, plus owner-direction-derived emotion and game-flow rows (web: Lazzaro four keys, SDT 2006, Juice it or lose it, peak-end rule, Celeste assist). Code check: 47 exist, 76 partial, 126 missing; 156 are 'must' for a complete base.

The owner's complaint is accurate. What exists and works: ECS runtime, one-cell movement, buffering, Shift-turn, Wooden Sword and Pencil Thrust, telegraph/dodge/attack-token pawn family (recruit, armed, backstep, charging, captain), 6 greybox Stage 1 rooms (T1-T4, B1, H1) on a world graph with fade travel, exit locks, sword unlock, one-way gates, autosave of zone/pickups/gates/unlocks/rule pages, the Book of House Rules (5 pages), SFX registry plus buses, wake animation, AnimationTree on 5 actors. Story is almost absent in code: it is only a few strings (room_message, one unlock line, 5 rule pages). Missing entirely: dialogue and cutscene systems, child presence and every intervention (Believe, Place Block, Chalk Path...), Rule Step, Eraser Guard, Final Rule Break, boss framework (phases, boss bar, arena seal, per-boss retry), Rook, Queen, King and 4 of 5 districts (Toybox through Under-Bed, about 20 rooms), the ending, title/pause/settings/credits/New Game, controller and remap, accessibility options, particles/hit-stop/lighting, localization/text-in-data, hub evolution, rescues, checkpoints.

Code defects against the docs: no attack movement lock, no stagger, input buffer never expires, turning allowed mid-step, all locked exits show the captain message, enemy attack clip is never driven (view_sync reads PlayerCombat), the Rule Book does not pause enemies, H1 leads into the legacy 72x40 kingdom, T2 still has a child whisper that the Act 1 map forbids, knight and bishop exist only in first_encounter.tscn, and the player cannot pick up weapons.

Decisions the newest owner direction forces (see conflicts): treat the whole Acts 0-6 chain as the deliverable, rooms-on-a-world-graph as the world model, Black Pawn Captain as first boss, v2 names and the six-verb skill set, one-cell enemy movement, low-punishment checkpoint rules, R reserved for Call child, and a manifest-driven art/audio swap contract so the owner can drop hand-drawn files in. Story and emotion should be authored as data (dialogue, beat map, boss beats, ending) so the owner can rewrite them.

Caveats: read-only audit; I did not run Godot tests (the 235 PASS figure is from docs/where-we-are.md and an earlier audit, unverified here). The repo moved since the brief's git snapshot: branch is game-base, HEAD bacca5c, Stage 1 committed as c46442f; only docs/progress edits are uncommitted. No repo file holds a verbatim owner quote, so all 'owner approved' records are agent paraphrase. The referent of the owner's opening '1 ok, but 2' is inferred, not documented."
